Front Desk Agent - The Gulfview Resort & Spa
Department: Guest Services
St. Pete Beach, FL
Full-time, year-round position.
Pay: $17.00 - $19.50 per hour depending on experience.

Responsibilities include checking guests in and out, handling reservations, and resolving guest concerns.

Requirements:
- 1+ years front desk or hospitality experience
- Available to work weekends and holidays
- Bilingual English/Spanish a plus
